items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Mosley Interview, 1961-09-23
items.q: And when it leave from there, going all the way around, it used to call that Grettony.

ctx.x: That's right, McDonnellville. I'll tell you how McDonnellville used to run from, this is what I tell you about the bridge. Yeah. Used to run as far as, like I tell you about the Young Man Hall up here. You know what I tell you on how it is. Yeah, that little hall. Yeah, well that was McDonnellville. And when it leave from there, going all the way around, it used to call that Grettony.
Did Grettony take all McDonnellville over?

That's all Grettony now. You don't call it McDonnellville no more. That's all Grettony. Right after you cross from under the bridge here, that's Jefferson Powers. That's all Grettony now. It's no more McDonnellville.
